card: Allows loadtxoutset to retry cleanly after an interrupted AssumeUTXO snapshot load without requiring manual disk cleanup. When an interrupted load leaves an incomplete chainstate_snapshot database missing its base_blockhash marker, subsequent load attempts fail. The PR sets should_wipe to true when activating the snapshot coins database so that retry calls wipe and overwrite partial data, and updates the startup warning log to reflect the retry behavior.
changed_since_previous: The PR has shifted scope completely: previously it handled removing stale chainstate_todelete directories during ValidatedSnapshotCleanup on node startup, whereas it now passes should_wipe=true when initializing the snapshot coins DB during loadtxoutset to recover from interrupted snapshot loads.
evidence: PR description and commit 15a891d402: 'An interrupted loadtxoutset can leave an incomplete chainstate_snapshot database without its required base_blockhash marker. A later call can fail to open that database, requiring the operator to remove it manually before retrying.'
problem: An interrupted loadtxoutset call can leave an incomplete chainstate_snapshot database without the base_blockhash marker file. Subsequent attempts to load a snapshot fail to open the database, requiring node operators to manually locate and delete the directory from disk.

risk.why: A mistake when instructing LevelDB to wipe an existing coins database during snapshot activation could accidentally discard valid chainstate data if applied to the wrong chainstate.

summary: Configures snapshot coins database initialization to wipe existing data before opening during AssumeUTXO snapshot activation. This allows subsequent loadtxoutset calls to succeed after an interrupted snapshot load, without requiring manual deletion of the chainstate_snapshot directory, and adjusts the malformed directory warning log accordingly.
